verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents rule-based automation, such as accept/reject logic for issuing transactions, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for this platform. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those rules or any other automations. The community items concern a data breach and are irrelevant to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
